title: Member of Technical Staff (Storage)
description:
Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, United States; San Mateo, CA; Toronto, Canada

 Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

 For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

 At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

 The Role

 We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains Pebble , an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and Plenum , the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently.

 In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.

 You Will

• Work on hard technical problems. Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.

• Lead through collaboration. Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.

• Be a trusted partner across the company. Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.

• Set the standard for engineering excellence. Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.

• Ship mission-critical software. Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don't know them, you'll learn while you're here.

 The Expectations

 In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.

 After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.

 After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.

 You Have

• Deep systems experience . 8+ years building complex distributed systems or storage software, including significant time working on distributed systems, concurrency control, file systems, data replication, I/O performance, or memory management.

• Storage architecture expertise . You have built or evolved a storage system such as log-structured merge-trees, blob storage, or cloud object storage.

• Production experience. Experience building, running, and debugging large-scale distributed systems in production and evolving systems through rolling upgrades.

• A collaborative approach. You have a passion for solving hard technical problems with others, sharing context, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback, and helping teammates succeed. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.

• Hands-on ability. You write production-ready code in systems programming languages like Go, Rust, or C/C++. You dig into hard bugs, profiles, and incidents when it matters.

 The Team

 Rachael Harding - Manager, Engineering

 Rachael leads the Storage team within the Database Engineering organization, where she oversees the development of Pebble and Plenum. Based in the Bay Area with her family, Rachael enjoys sampling pastries, exploring local parks, and baking with her kids.

 Nick Travers - Director, Engineering

 Nick joined Cockroach Labs in 2021 and leads Database Engineering - the group of teams building CockroachDB. Originally from Perth, Australia, he lives in Los Angeles with his family. Arsenal supporter, cook, outdoors person.

 Isaac Wong - EVP of Research & Development

 Isaac is responsible for the health of the engineering organization at Cockroach Labs. He partners closely with teams to ensure we have a balanced culture that promotes quality and innovation in pursuit of our goals. Before joining Cockroach Labs Isaac was in life sciences for 16 years with Medidata Solutions where he had a front row seat on the exciting ride from a 30 person startup to more than 2000 people worldwide. But the lure of distributed, resilient, and consistent SQL databases, along with the amazing technology and culture at Cockroach Labs proved too much. When not working he likes to draw, play the piano, and search NYC for cannoli's with his wife and kids.

 Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com .

 Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

• And more!

Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds for professional development, flexible paid time off, paid sick days and holidays, paid parental leave, and wellbeing benefits. We have a match on 401(k) contributions in the U.S.

Benefits programs are designed according to local market practices. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.

title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 The Community You Will Join:

 People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.

 The Difference You Will Make:

 The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.

 If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb’s community, we want to hear from you.

 A Typical Day:

• Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze

• Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others

• Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business

• Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders

• Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards

• Lead design and measurement of Airbnb's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting

• Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

• Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

 Your Expertise:

• 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field

• Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis

• Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access

• Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit

• Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact

• Experience working with large practical datasets

 Your Location:

 This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

 Equal Employment Opportunity :

 Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.
 How We'll Take Care of You:

 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

 Pay Range
 $180,000 — $210,000 USD

 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

 Who we are

 Responsibilities

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 The Team

 The Data team builds and runs the systems that make Stability AI's data usable, both to operate the business and to train our models. We're a small, collaborative team that works closely with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research. We focus on outcomes rather than hours, and you'll have deep technical access and the freedom to build.

 Our stack: AWS (S3, Athena, Glue, EMR, Step Functions, EventBridge), Iceberg, dbt, Postgres, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, QuickSight, Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, Customer.io, PostHog, OpenTelemetry and SLURM — or similar. We care about the judgement more than the logo.

 The Work

 You'll own our company data platform end to end: the AWS data lake, the transformation layer, the integrations between our business systems, and the Kubernetes-based infrastructure they run on. The data that runs the business (billing, usage telemetry, identity, CRM, ERP, cloud cost) lives in a dozen systems that were never wired together. You'll be the engineer who connects them and keeps them reliable.

 You'll also be the data engineer for our research teams across audio, video, image and 3D, building the pipelines that turn raw media into training-ready datasets. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, not a data-prep or analyst seat.

• Own the company data platform end to end: the S3/Athena/Glue lake, the dbt project and its daily build, ingestion from Stripe, Auth0, HubSpot, OpenTelemetry and product events, and the Postgres serving layer for dashboards and AI agents

• Build and operate integrations between billing, CRM, ERP, identity and telemetry systems so revenue, usage, cost and customer identity reconcile automatically instead of through spreadsheets and tickets

• Design and maintain the warehouse layer: dimensional models, data contracts with product engineering for event schemas, quality tests, lineage and a catalog

• Enforce PII tiering (open vs. restricted schemas) through access grants, working with Security and Legal

• Process data at scale: billions of telemetry rows, terabyte log streams, Iceberg tables, partitioning and cost control

• Own orchestration and infrastructure: orchestration on EKS, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, and join the business-hours on-call rotation for the daily pipelines

• Deliver operational reporting for Finance and leadership: revenue by business line, credits and prepaid liability, and cloud cost by department

• Support the research teams across every modality: source, license-check, ingest and version large training datasets for audio, video, image and 3D

• Build the generation, filtering, deduplication and captioning pipelines that turn raw or synthetic media into training-ready shards, and run them at scale on our SLURM cluster and cloud object storage

• Keep lineage, quality metrics and dataset documentation current so any researcher can reproduce a training set

• Lead design reviews, mentor teammates and write the runbooks that remove single-person dependencies

• Partner with Finance, Marketing, SRE, Security, Product and Research on company-wide data initiatives

 What You Bring

 We're looking for an engineer who pairs strong software engineering habits with warehouse. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering habits with warehouse modelling depth, and the judgement to say what a number means and what it does not.

 Experience

• 6+ years building and running production data platforms, including ownership of the architecture

• Experience integrating SaaS business systems (Stripe, HubSpot, an ERP, an identity provider) into a warehouse

• Production experience preparing large multimodal training datasets and running batch workloads on HPC or cloud schedulers (SLURM, Kubernetes or similar)

• Comfort working independently in a small team with real ownership

 Skills & Expertise

• Expert SQL and Python, with strong software engineering habits: tests, code review and CI

• Warehouse and lake experience with real modelling: Iceberg or Delta on S3, Athena/Trino, Snowflake or BigQuery, and dbt

• An orchestrator in production (dbt, Airflow or Argo) and distributed processing (Spark or equivalent)

• AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm and Terraform — you can debug a failing Glue job and a broken Helm release

 Additional Strengths

• Prior 0-to-1 platform ownership at a startup

• Experience working with research teams on generative models, or hands-on exposure to audio, video, image or 3D data

• FinOps and cloud cost reporting

• Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar compliance requirements for data access

 Benefits & Compensation

 Outside the United States
Compensation and benefits are set for each country’s market and local practice. If you’re applying from outside the U.S., your recruiter will share the details for your country early in the process.

 United States

• A remote-first company with teammates across multiple countries who bring diverse perspectives, and flexibility built into how we collaborate.

• Health coverage for you and your family. Choose from PPO and HMO plans, including select plans where Stability AI covers 100% of premiums for you and your eligible dependents.

• HSA and FSA accounts to set aside pre-tax dollars for healthcare and other eligible expenses.

• Company-paid life insurance, with the option to add voluntary coverage for yourself, your spouse, and your children.

• Short- and long-term disability coverage, to protect part of your income if illness or injury keeps you from working.

• 401(k) with company match of up to 4%.

• Paid parental leave to support you as your family grows.

• Flexible paid time off, plus paid company holidays.

• The equipment you need to do your best work, provided by Stability AI.

 At Stability AI, we aim to pay fairly and competitively, and we believe you should know what a role pays before you invest time in getting to know us. The annual base salary range for this role is $175,500 - $230,000 USD. It reflects our good-faith expectation for the role as posted and applies to candidates hired within the United States.

 Where you fall within that range depends on the depth and relevance of your experience, your skills, and how you perform in our interview process. Because great candidates don’t always map neatly to a single level, we may also consider someone for a level above or below the one posted. If we do, the range will be adjusted to match, and we’ll talk it through with you openly.

 Base salary is also just one part of your total compensation. Eligible employees take part in our equity program and receive the benefits described above. We’d rather talk about all of this early than leave you guessing, so your recruiter is happy to walk you through the range, how offers come together, and anything else that matters to you, at any point in the process.

 Privacy Policy

 To learn how we collect, use, and protect your information during the hiring process, see our Privacy Policy .

This is not a traditional product QA role - it’s a build role.  Hands-on experience with micro-services, Kubernetes and managing deployment lifecycle

 Ability to take an ambiguous problem statement to a scoped, defensible solution independently.

That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

What You'll Do

  • Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business.
  • Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading.
  • Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth.
  • Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale.
  • Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience.
  • Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products.
  • You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics.
  • You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences.
  • You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that help teams move faster.
  • You know how to balance user needs, technical considerations, and business impact when making product decisions.
  • You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences at scale.
  • You have partnered closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and other disciplines to bring products from strategy through delivery.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making thoughtful trade-offs, and creating clarity across teams.
  • You can influence stakeholders across functions and levels to build alignment and drive meaningful outcomes.
  • You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, including for research, analysis, iteration, and prototyping.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

title: Content Marketing Lead, Insights
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is building the content engine that makes the market see TRM as the authority on crypto crime and financial-crime intelligence. As Content Marketing Lead for Research & Insights, you will turn the work of our Insights team into reports, articles, and campaigns that customers, journalists, and the wider crime-fighting community read, cite, and act on. You will own a proactive plan for which research stories TRM tells, when, and for whom, and make sure each one reaches the right audience.

The impact you will have:

  • Set the research content agenda. Build and own a proactive editorial plan with the Insights team that decides which findings become flagship reports, blog posts, social content, or media pitches, using AI to scan the research pipeline and surface the stories worth telling.

  • Turn research into a content engine. Carry findings from concept to published, distributed content and handle roughly 1 to 3 pieces a week, using AI workflows across review, drafting, and repurposing so quality holds as volume grows.

  • Decide the argument, then let AI accelerate production. Shape and pressure-test each narrative and its data yourself, then use AI to draft variants, headlines, and channel-specific cuts so more of your time goes to judgment and less to production.

  • Own distribution for everything you produce. Plan how each piece reaches its audience before it publishes, push it across owned, paid, and earned channels, and use AI to tailor it for social, the newsletter, and executive voice.

  • Grow TRM's search and AI-citation visibility. Produce the content that makes TRM the cited authority on priority themes, and use SEO and GEO tooling to find gaps and measure what moves.

  • Support media outreach. Work alongside TRM's head of Comms on journalist outreach for research releases, feed what you learn from coverage back into the content plan, and tune what works for the next release.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of B2B content marketing, editorial, or research-communications experience, with a portfolio of data- or research-based point-of-view work.

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across research review, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, and you build workflows others can reuse.

  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to strengthen complex, technical narratives without sacrificing accuracy, including when AI produced the first draft.

  • Experience owning a piece end to end, from concept through publication and distribution, and proactively planning content rather than only fulfilling requests.

  • A distribution mindset, with comfort using AI and analytics to measure and improve how content performs.

  • The ability to translate technical, data-driven material into clear, engaging content, using AI to adapt tone and format for different audiences.

About the Team:

  • You will join Content & Brand Marketing within GTM Marketing, working hand in hand with the Insights team in Primary Intelligence and with Demand Gen and Comms.

  • The work is dedicated to data and research-based storytelling: TRM's credibility depends on the market seeing our intelligence and domain expertise, and this role scales that output.

  • It is a small, senior, AI-native team that expects ownership, pace, and strong judgment, and gives you real latitude to decide what TRM should be known for.

  • The hard part is intellectual: challenging researchers, finding the angle that makes a finding matter, and keeping quality high as volume grows.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across the US and Europe/UK and keeps collaboration-hours overlap so ideas move quickly.

  • Async-first communication with regular syncs; the editorial calendar is the team's shared source of truth.

  • Close, continuous partnership with researchers, Demand Gen, and Comms rather than handoffs.

  • AI is part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Overlap with US-based team collaboration hours; specific hours confirmed at offer.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or event travel.

  • Frequency: Occasional.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: None; fully remote.

  • Frequency: None.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • In your first 30 days, publish a research piece end to end, from concept to distribution, with a plan for how it reaches its audience.

  • Within 60 days, stand up an AI-assisted production workflow that lets the team ship 1 to 3 research pieces a week without adding headcount.

  • Within 90 days, move a flagship finding from idea to press-ready and placed, measurably lifting reach and search or AI-citation visibility on a priority theme.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000-$188,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiv

title: VP of Global Growth
description:

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM is hiring a VP of Global Growth to lead our next stage of expansion, building a global growth organization that delivers repeatable, scalable, and efficient growth.

You will own global pipeline generation across the company and the customer journey from initial awareness through to a sales-accepted opportunity. You will report directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, be a key member of our Growth Leadership Team, and lead teams across growth strategy, digital and lifecycle marketing, account-based marketing, field marketing, and marketing operations and analytics. You will establish attribution, experimentation, and funnel visibility to understand what’s working, address what isn’t, and guide TRM on where to invest to drive growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the pipeline generation plan. Translate revenue targets into pipeline requirements by market, region, offering, and customer type. Account for conversion rates and sales cycles, agree contributions with other revenue leaders, and own the consolidated plan and response to gaps.

  • Find and attack the bottlenecks. Map how accounts and buyers move from awareness to qualified opportunities, define the entry and exit criteria for each stage, and identify where progress stalls. Work with Sales to improve handoffs and use win/loss results to sharpen targeting and programs.

  • Lead the full demand generation engine. Integrate demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, account-based marketing (ABM), field marketing, and digital into a coordinated strategy that generates qualified pipeline across global pods. Connect events, executive programs, content, and coordinated sales outreach to explicit pipeline goals.

  • Build digital and lifecycle capabilities. Lead paid search and social, organic search and AI discovery, website conversion, landing pages, nurture, and reactivation. Understand how these channels work together and where additional investment can generate qualified pipeline efficiently.

  • Increase experimentation velocity. Diagnose where the growth engine underperforms, prioritize high-impact hypotheses, and establish a fast, disciplined cadence of experiments across audiences, channels, campaigns, and conversion paths. Use AI to accelerate targeting, campaign operations, content production, and analysis while maintaining quality.

  • Build a stunning team and culture. Develop the existing team, recruit critical talent, and set clear responsibilities across shared capabilities and market teams. Own the budget and agency relationships, establish a disciplined operating rhythm, and use AI and automation to increase the team’s capacity and speed.

  • Executive leadership: Serve as the executive voice for pipeline generation, advising the CRO, CEO, and broader leadership team on pipeline performance, investment tradeoffs, and opportunities across markets and customer segments.

What we’re looking for:

  • A track record of owning and growing qualified pipeline in an enterprise technology business with complex buying groups and long sales cycles. You can explain the targets, investment decisions, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes behind your results.

  • Quantitative fluency and sound judgment with imperfect data. You can build a funnel model, pressure-test attribution, evaluate acquisition economics, and design useful experiments when volumes are too small for simple A/B tests.

  • A track record driving both new-logo acquisition and customer expansion, with a rigorous understanding of conversion, acquisition economics, and payback.

  • Deep full-funnel expertise, from awareness and MQL generation through opportunity creation, Sales handoffs, and downstream pipeline outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success building multitouch attribution, marketing analytics, and forecasting models that improve investment decisions and reveal where the funnel is underperforming.

  • A disciplined approach to experimentation, with evidence of increasing testing velocity and translating learning into measurable improvements in qualified pipeline and conversion.

  • Experience leading demand generation, performance marketing, lifecycle, ABM, digital, and regional or field marketing, supported by strong marketing operations and data analytics.

  • Applied AI fluency: you can show how you have used AI to improve campaign operations, targeting, content velocity, forecasting, or attribution, with appropriate quality controls.

  • A track record hiring and developing leaders and building an operating model that creates accountability across teams and functions.

  • Multi-region experience across NA, APAC, and EMEA, ideally including public-sector or regulated-buyer motions, with the judgment to tailor strategy by market and segment.

  • Strong executive communication and GTM partnership. You can align leaders on the growth plan, challenge assumptions with evidence, and move comfortably between revenue outcomes and campaign detail.

This role may be a fit if you…

  • Have willed extraordinarily ambitious programs and teams into existence

  • Look at a funnel and immediately hypothesize about bottlenecks and experiments to run

  • Are as energized by developing a market strategy as you are by building a campaign, rewriting a landing page, or fixing a broken handoff

  • Experiment constantly with AI and find yourself teaching others how to uplevel their usage

  • Need to be at a company where you can draw a straight line from the work you do to a positive impact in your community

title: Account Manager - Speech & AI Technologies
description:
About Side

Side is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 15+ studios in over a dozen countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. We're seeking an Account Manager who will lead high-profile relationships within the speech and AI ecosystem. This role combines technical fluency, partnership management, legal and commercial awareness. The successful candidate will act as a trusted interface between client technical teams and internal delivery teams, ensuring alignment, solution clarity, and long-term partnership stability.

This is not a pure sales role. It requires strong technical credibility and a customer-first mindset.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary relationship lead for a major enterprise technology partner within the speech and AI domain.
  • Engage directly with client stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML, Data Science, and Speech teams.
  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear internal delivery plans and execution roadmaps.
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and operational capabilities across data, engineering, and production teams.
  • Demonstrate domain fluency across TTS, ASR, transcription workflows, data collection, annotation, and model training support.
  • Contribute technical insight during solution design discussions, including conversations around model accuracy, constraints, scaling, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Protect and stabilize existing revenue streams while supporting responsible expansion aligned with the client’s technical roadmap.
  • Participate in RFP/RFI responses and commercial discussions with awareness of scope, margin, and delivery risk.
  • Partner closely with delivery, data operations, engineering, and product teams to ensure seamless transition from scoping to execution.
  • Identify risks early, escalate appropriately, and maintain transparency across stakeholders.
  • Build long-term trust through responsiveness, clarity, and professionalism in complex enterprise environments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience within speech technology, AI/ML services, data annotation, data collection, or language technologies.
  • Experience working with large technology platforms or enterprise AI customers.
  • Technical fluency in deep learning-based TTS and ASR systems, voice technologies, NLP fundamentals, and model training pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of annotation workflows, dataset management, and model evaluation concepts.
  • Comfort engaging directly with engineering, ML, and product stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and operational teams.
  • Commercial awareness and structured account management discipline within enterprise environments.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary 
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • annual leave plus public holidays
  • Private healthcare options
  • Life assurance and income protection coverage
  • Professional development support and learning opportunities
  • International exposure across global teams and clients
  • A collaborative, people-first culture within a growing global organization

title: Teacher of Personal Social Health & Citizenship Education
description:
We are looking for a passionate person who is ambitious for our students and community and will support our inclusive ethos.

Applications are sought from high calibre professionals who have the skills and talent to continue to develop the department and work as part of our committed team.

Holmer Green is a popular 11 to 18 school with 1250 students (200+ in the Sixth Form) and is expanding. The school has a range of newly built modern facilities which now includes a purpose-built English and Maths block, new cafeteria and fitness suite.

We can offer 8 staff training days (not the 5 you find in most schools), a two-week October half term and professional development of a high standard. We take our staff well-being seriously and offer weekly activities, like team sports, free use of a fitness suite, a Staff Forum, access to Employee Assistance Programme, car parking, paid lunch duties plus free lunch

Duties and Responsibilities

To be committed to the safeguarding and well-being of all students and to follow school Policy and procedures in this regard.

The major task of teachers is to enable all students to achieve their full potential (social, physical, emotional and intellectual) by developing in them relevant skills, competencies, attitudes, concepts and knowledge. Teachers should use their professional judgements and skills to help students to acquire the confidence to tackle all aspects of learning throughout their lives. They should seek to enhance self-esteem and self-fulfilment of students through a supportive, encouraging, yet challenging approach to learning.

Teachers will achieve these aims by working at or towards the professional standards at the appropriate level. All teachers will be expected to prepare, teach, mark work and keep appropriate records of assessment of designated groups within Team or Departmental areas in accordance with school and department policies. A wide variety of teaching styles suited to the needs of individuals and small groups as well as whole classes should be adopted.

All teachers will be expected to work collaboratively with other staff as members of teams, departments and/or other cross-curricular groups. They will contribute their own particular talents and skills to such groups to aid the production of new initiatives, policies, resources, schemes of work etc.

In collaboration with students and support staff, all teachers are responsible for caring for the School environment, and teachers take responsibility for their own rooms.

Teachers should have a concern for the academic and general welfare of students in their care during specific lessons, but teachers who are tutors (and most are) are expected to take a broader responsibility for the development and progression of a group of students.

Much is expected of teachers at Holmer Green Senior School in order to meet both their own professional fulfilment and the aims of the School, but all staff also have the right to appropriate support, learning and development opportunities and INSET through formal and informal contact with colleagues, particularly Heads of Department, and members of the Leadership Team.

Teachers are encouraged to assist in the development of any aspects of the school to which they feel drawn.

Qualifications Required

Good honours degree or equivalent

Qualified Teacher Status

Evidence of recent or relevant training and development and/or further study

Holmer Green Senior School is committed to the welfare and safeguarding of all its students and therefore all appointments are made subject to satisfactory Enhanced DBS, qualification and pre-employment checks

We will carry out an online search (including social media) as part of our due diligence on the shortlisted candidates. This may help identify any incidents or issues that have happened, and are publicly available online, which the school might want to explore with the applicant at interview. Shortlisted candidates will also be asked to complete a safer recruitment self-declaration form before interview


The school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date should a suitable candidate become available

description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

 Who we are

 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 .

 Hiring and how we work

 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
 .

 See yourself at Twilio

 Join the team as Twilio’s next Commercial Finance Manager, Carrier Relations

 About the job

 Join the Finance team supporting carrier supplier negotiations and wholesale trading transactions. In this role, you will lead the financial assessment of complex agreements, shape commercially sound deal structures, and deliver clear recommendations to executive decision-makers. While Carrier Relations leads the direct supplier negotiations, you will serve as their strategic Finance partner—owning the deal economics, mitigating financial risk, and ensuring approval quality.

 Responsibilities

 In this role, you’ll:

• Lead financial diligence for complex and high-value carrier agreements and relevant wholesale transactions across, including those with nonstandard commercial structures. Evaluate pricing, margin, regulatory pass-through fees, commitments, payment terms, cash flow impacts, and other sources of financial exposure.

• Build and review deal models and scenarios that show how proposed terms perform under changes in volume, traffic mix, rates, and other key assumptions. Recommend structures and negotiation guardrails based on the analysis.

• Partner with Carrier Relations, Routing Operations, and other stakeholders to drive resolution of financial deal decisions, document trade-offs, and move deals through the appropriate approval path. Escalate material exceptions to executive committees with a clear recommendation.

• Own the design and continuous improvement of the Deal Desk Finance process, including required inputs, review steps, approval guardrails, exception handling, and handoffs. Establish standardized deal models and analysis practices, and define business requirements for Salesforce or other enterprise workflows. Partner with Systems and business teams on solution design, testing, and adoption.

• Track key commitments and deal assumptions after signature, identify emerging exposure, and use actual performance to improve future deal decisions and guardrails.

• Identify recurring deal themes, risks, and opportunities, and translate them into practical improvements to policy, process, and commercial strategy.

• Coach senior analysts on modeling, financial judgment, and executive recommendations. Partner with the Finance Director to build and refine how the Carrier Deal Desk operates.

 Qualifications

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

• 8+ years in commercial finance, strategic finance, procurement finance, pricing, Deal Desk, or a related analytical role involving complex commercial agreements.

• Strong financial modeling skills and the judgment to independently evaluate supplier economics, test assumptions, assess risk, and recommend a course of action.

• Demonstrated experience leading the financial strategy for high-stakes vendor negotiations, including structuring pricing, volume commitments, cash flow terms, and mitigating nonstandard commercial risks.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance and commercial teams, communicate financial trade-offs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions toward resolution.

• Experience establishing analytical standards, financial guardrails, or approval processes and coaching other analysts as a senior individual contributor.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce or similar workflow systems and enterprise financial systems; Oracle experience is a plus.

 Desired:

• Spanish or Portuguese language skills are a plus.

 Location

 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas.

 Travel

 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

 What We Offer

title: Head of Design
description:
Headquarters: Germany (Remote); London, United Kingdom; Poland (Remote); Romania (Remote)

 At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

 We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

 We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 About the role

 We're looking for a Head of Design who still loves to design. You'll lead a small, strong team of product designers, set the bar for craft and for how we work with AI, and spend about half your time designing with some of our teams.

 Ledgy's problems are dense and high-stakes: finance, legal and HR teams use us to manage real ownership and real money across many countries. Design here has to be precise and still feel simple. As the company grows into new markets and new products, you'll shape what design at Ledgy becomes.

 Design at Ledgy is AI-first. Work starts with AI models, moves into working prototypes in our codebase, and lands in Figma for the system. Every team ships agent features. You'll make sure the whole team does this well, consistently, and with judgement.

 Reports to: VP of Product

 Location: Hybrid from our London office, remote in the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland or Romania

 What you'll do

 Lead the team (~50%)

• Manage and grow three product designers working across our product teams: regular 1:1s, honest feedback, clear growth paths.

• Hire: help shape roles, run interviews and grow the team as Ledgy grows.

• Partner with product and engineering leadership on planning, staffing and the design vision across all teams.

• Own the direction of our design system and shared AI patterns (how agents ask, act, explain and undo), together with engineering.

• Define how we design with AI: tools, workflows, prototypes in code, shared skills and prompts. Make it easy for every designer to work this way.

• Run design critique and design reviews, and own the quality bar across the product.

 Design hands-on (~50%)

• Be the designer for one of our teams (for example Tax, Trading, AI Systems - to be decided together): contribute to Ledgy’s product experiences, from agents and AI-assisted workflows to the our trading integrations and compliance reporting

• Prototype in code in our real codebase, and open small front-end PRs when it's faster than a handoff.

• Set the example: work in the open, show your thinking, ship.

 You'll thrive here if you

• Have 10+ years in product design on complex B2B or data-dense products, including 2+ years leading or managing designers.

• Still design and prototype yourself, and want to keep doing it.

• Are AI-native: you know when to prototype, when to stop and think, which tool fits which job, and how to turn that into habits a team can share.

• Understand how AI agents work well enough to design for them and argue with engineers about them: the model, the harness, tool calls, APIs, audit trails.

• Build your own tools: prompts, skills, small automations, and help others build theirs.

• Raise quality through people, not just through your own work: you've grown designers and improved how a team works.

• Communicate clearly with leadership and influence decisions across product and engineering. Fluent English.

 Nice to have

• Experience in equity, fintech, tax, payroll or accounting software.

• Led design for AI or agent products that shipped to real customers.

• Built or evolved a design system in code.

 What your journey could look like

• First 30 days: Meet every designer, PM and EM; learn the product and our customers; review how the team works today.

• First 3 months: Run the team's rituals, ship your first work, and propose how design should work with AI across teams.

• 6–12 months: Grow the team, raise the craft bar visibly, and set the design vision for the next stage of Ledgy.

 Our interview process

• Recruiter call (30 min): you, us, the role, logistics.

• Hiring manager interview (45 min): how you work, lead and decide.

• Portfolio presentation (60 min): two projects, at least one showing how you work with AI, and one story about building or leading a team.

• AI working session (3.5h, live): frame a problem with a PM and a designer, build it with your own AI tools, and critique a piece of work as you would with your team.

• Final interview (45 min): with one of our founders.

 You'll get a short guide before each step.

title: Senior QA Automation Developer (HELOC)
description:

 Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

 We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture.  We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

 We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Developer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a new quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities.  Our Core Technologies Include:

 Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc

 Environmental & Working Conditions

 Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

 The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

 Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

 Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

 Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

title: Customer Success Manager (AI Success Architect)
description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

 Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate. As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

 This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays . Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner . If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements .

 What you’ll achieve

•
 Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

•
 Build joint success plans that connect strategic customer goals to measurable results, leading business reviews focused on outcomes and value rather than just usage.

•
 Diagnose customer workflows and map them to Asana’s AI capabilities (AI Studio, AI Teammates, and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP) to replace manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

•
 Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

•
 Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

•
 Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

•
 Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

•
 Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

•
 Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

 About you

•
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

•
 5+ years of experience in customer success, strategic account management, or enterprise technology, with a track record of driving delivery and adoption for complex, high-value accounts.

•
 Proven background managing enterprise relationships across both technical and business stakeholders.

•
 Solid understanding of how AI agents function, workflow automation principles, and where AI provides substantial versus incremental impact.

•
 Comfort discussing pricing, ROI, and commercial outcomes with senior executives, ideally within consumption-based models.

•
 Strong competency in change management and program management across concurrent, long-term initiatives.

•
 Effective communication skills across audiences, from executive presentations to tactical working sessions with operations teams.

•
 Ability to navigate fast-paced, ambiguous environments with sound judgment.

•
 Willingness to travel up to 20% to customer sites as needed.

•
 Expe rience with enterprise AI, automation, or workflow platforms (or familiarity with MCP) is a plus.

 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

 What we’ll offer

 Our comprehens ive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission . We bel ieve that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role . title: Engagement Manager
description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

 For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

 Smartsheet is a tech company with a human story to tell. We’re here to empower teams to manage projects, automate workflows, and rapidly build new secure solutions, using simple no-code tools. We’re revolutionaries – so for us changing the way the world works is all in a day’s work.

 As an Engagement Manager within Customer Excellence and Professional Services at Smartsheet, you will play a critical role in setting customers up for success by prescriptively crafting and then leading the execution of large and transformative enterprise projects for our most strategic customers. The Engagement Manager serves as a trusted advisor to Smartsheet customers, provides mentorship to Sales & Professional Services teams, drives alignment across each customer’s projects, and ensures the highest customer satisfaction levels.

 Partnered with the Account Team, Services Sales, and Service Delivery, the Engagement Manager contributes to pre-sales scoping and discovery activities, acting as a conduit across the organization to develop and articulate comprehensive implementation proposals. The Engagement Manager will then maintain the executive relationships and act as a critical issue point within these implementations in a billable capacity, ensuring tight customer alignment and offering proactive and prescriptive advice resulting in outstanding Customer Success.

 As the Engagement Manager, you will manage several projects/programs concurrently spanning 1 or more Large Enterprise customers. Engagement managers will have a targeted utilization rate, be responsible for the development of best practices, and will manage business processes.

 You will report to the Manager of Engagement Delivery, this is a remote eligible position and you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is registered

 You Will:

• Support the account team with pre-sales scoping and discovery activities through Discovery Workshops and pre-engagement planning sessions with the customer

• Actively enroll the required staff resources at the right time to maximize impact, utilization and customer outcomes.

• Manage and drive competing requests across simultaneous strategic client engagements.

• Identify, pull together, and drive project activities of teams from cross-functional and partner sources

• Provide insight into Engagement and Client level revenue forecasting for Monthly and Quarterly targets

• Manage project to time, budget, and contracted deliverables (including planning, scheduling, milestone reviews, etc.)

• Manage project P&L to targeted margin results

• Drive project reviews for management and customers. As requested, support the account team with preparing and leading customer Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) during and after project execution

• Operate as additional eyes and ears within current accounts to identify and unlock follow-on opportunities.

• Create momentum to accelerate delivery and shorten time to value with our customers

• Ensure that engagements conclude with delighted clients that are willing to be referenced for new potential clients

• Proactively mitigate and handle critical customer concerns and at-risk accounts; communicate optimally and appropriately with internal and external leaders and executives.

• Own the escalation response using a consistent, documented escalation process and coordination for active projects and provide mentorship on escalation management to other Professional Services team members

• Ensure quality and time management processes are followed by the team e.g., change controls, time card submissions, status reporting, risk and issue logging)

• Contribute to the development and ownership of the Smartsheet Delivery Methodology and Professional Services PMO function

• Contribute to engagement delivery standard operating procedures (SOPs)

• Function as a frontline resource for “best practice” and informal customer questions

• Liaison with necessary teams within Smartsheet to achieve the above items

• Other duties as assigned

 You Have:

• 4+ years of experience in customer-facing positions in a professional capacity ideally at Software or SaaS Provider

• At least 2 years of Project and Program Management experience at the enterprise level

• 2+ years of experience, leading customer-facing engagements in the enterprise space

• Management of large billable projects for external customers

• Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate drafting, analysis, and process design, with sound judgment on accuracy, confidentiality, and customer data handling.

• Experience with modern services deployment methodologies, with emphasis on software design and development

• Use of formal project management tools

• Expert-Level Scope control for fixed-fee engagements.

• Passion for working with leading-edge, web-based technologies and a desire to understand Smartsheet’s benefits, values, use cases, and business and technical elements

• Desire to work in a collaborative environment to promote and improve team performance

• Strong analytical skills regarding client and project management issues

• Strong organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands

• Ability to interact and communicate with CxO-level personnel with confidence and clarity

• Excellent communications and interpersonal skills

• One or more Industry Recognized Certifications Including;

• Project Management Professional Certification (PMP)

• Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

• Lean or Six Sigma certification

• Smartsheet Core and/or Project Management Certification

• Advanced degree (Masters Level) preferred or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and education

• Willing to travel periodically (up to 20-30%) based on customer and business needs

• Authorization to work in the U.S. for any employer on an ongoing basis

• Has Smartsheet Certified Professional credential or has the ability to become certified within 3 months

• Experience with process improvement and the development of tools & processes that enable team member success

 Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

title: Entrepreneur in Residence/Product Lead
description:
Headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia

 Are you a builder who thrives in ambiguity, gets energy from talking to real users, and wants to turn emerging agentic AI capabilities into a product people actually rely on?

 About JetBrains

 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

 What you’ll do

 NoPressure is an early-stage startup within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. We started by using AI-powered simulations to help people practice high-stakes workplace conversations. Now, we're exploring how agentic AI and real-world context can provide personalized, moment-of-need practice and support at work.

 We’re looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence / Product Lead to partner with our technical founder. This is a 0→1 role where you’ll define our vision and venture strategy. You’ll figure out who our ideal customer is, identify high-value use cases, and validate key hypotheses through rapid experimentation. Working alongside a small, fast-moving engineering team, you will shape both the product and how it gets to market, turning early signals into something organizations want to adopt.

 Day to day, you will:

• Define the product and venture strategy, identifying key uncertainties and deciding what to test and build first.

• Conduct continuous customer discovery to understand real workplace workflows, pain points, and behaviors.

• Pinpoint the most compelling ideal customer profile (ICP) and initial use cases for growth.

• Design and run lightweight experiments, prototypes, and agentic experiences to test hypotheses before committing full engineering resources.

• Establish clear metrics and evaluate commercial and behavioral evidence to decide whether to iterate, double down, or pivot.

• Shape positioning, messaging, and early acquisition or sales motions to bring the product to initial customers.

• Monitor market shifts, emerging agent architectures, and competitor developments to uncover new opportunities.

• Collaborate closely with the technical founder and engineering team to move quickly from ideas to shipped prototypes.

 What you’ll bring

• A builder mindset that favors quick prototypes and direct learning over waiting for perfect requirements.

• Deep curiosity about how people build new skills and navigate challenging interactions at work.

• Comfort operating with high autonomy, speed, and decision-making under uncertainty.

• Strong discovery skills that separate genuine demand and observed behavior from polite validation.

• Clear, direct communication skills for pitching to and working with senior decision-makers.

• Strong collaboration habits when partnering closely with engineering teams on AI-native products.

 What you’ll need

• A Track record of taking products or ventures from initial ambiguity to launch and early market adoption.

• Hands-on experience building, launching, or experimenting with AI/agentic products or emerging technologies.

• Demonstrated experience in early customer acquisition, founder-led sales, positioning, or commercialization.

• Experience in L&D, coaching, sales enablement, HR tech, or behavior-change products.

• The technical fluency required to evaluate agentic workflows and work directly alongside software engineers.

• End-to-end ownership experience across strategy, discovery, product development, and go-to-market strategy.

 What success looks like

 In this role, success means rapidly turning market ambiguity into actionable direction. You will establish a validated ideal customer profile and high-value use cases through real user evidence rather than assumptions. You’ll build an experimental cadence that uncovers genuine demand early, helping the team ship an agentic AI experience that users regularly rely on and organizations actively invest in.

 Why join JetBrains?

• Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

• Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.

• Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.

• Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.

• Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.

• Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.

• Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.

• Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.
