title: Software Engineer (Go)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

As a Software Engineer within our Billing group, you will play a key role in developing core areas of our new billing platform. You’ll provide world-class experiences to thousands of customers who use and trust Paddle every day. You'll take the lead on discovering new features, planning their implementation, and contributing your technical expertise to shape the future of our billing platform.

You’ll collaborate with multiple teams—engineers, product managers, and designers—working across a wide range of areas that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career as a valued member of our engineering team.

What you'll do:

  • Independently deliver on milestones that may span across multiple systems within Billing.

  • Make changes with care and precision, recognising the importance of correctness when working with financial data.

  • Contribute to systems designed for scale, reliability, and security, following established architectural patterns.

  • Write clear, well-structured, and well-tested code that meets team standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.

  • Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and designers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Break down larger pieces of work into manageable tasks and estimate your own work with guidance.

  • Help monitor and support production services, investigating and fixing issues as they arise.

  • Contribute to shaping our team and wider engineering culture to ensure Paddle remains an exceptional place to work.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data, Risk, and Operations to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Help shape product direction by providing technical insights, trade-offs, and delivery estimates.

  • Partner with Customer Support or Operations teams to investigate and resolve production issues.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a development background with Go.

  • Have experience designing and building systems to handle high traffic at scale in a cloud-based environment in AWS

  • Are someone who enjoys collaborating with our technical and non-technical departments

  • Have a proactive attitude towards finding ways to improve the code and team processes.

  • A strong understanding of the development process - from design through to deployment, maintenance, and what that means for day-to-day development.

  • A strong understanding of API principles and best practices.

  • A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus.

  • Solid communication and collaboration skills, you should be comfortable working alongside both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Are someone who takes pride in what you build.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
About Cobalt

At Cobalt, we believe everyone deserves to live and work in a safer, more secure world. Founded in 2013 on the belief that penetration testing could – and should – be better, we set out to challenge the status quo and transform how organizations approach offensive security.

Today, we’re leading the way in transforming the offensive security market, bringing together world-class security expertise, innovative technology and a global community of security professionals to make security testing more seamless, effective and collaborative. Our diverse, fully-remote team partners with organizations of all sizes to help them OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

And we’re just getting started!

AI is fundamentally reshaping the cybersecurity landscape, creating new opportunities, new challenges and entirely new ways of thinking about security. At Cobalt, we’re not waiting to see what happens next; we’re helping define it. We’re challenging conventions, pushing boundaries and reimagining what’s possible in offensive security.

Customers can launch a pentest in as little as 24 hours through our SaaS platform and exclusive Cobalt Core community. With 500+ highly vetted security testers, representing just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core conducts thousands of tests annually, helping organizations identify and remediate risk across their evolving attack surfaces.

This is an exciting time to join Cobalt. We’re looking for ambitious, creative and agile leaders who thrive on change, think beyond traditional playbooks and have the vision to create new categories, shape markets and build what comes next. If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a real impact in a market undergoing significant transformation, we’d love you to be part of our journey.

Description

Cobalt is looking for a Channel Account Manager to develop, manage, and grow our technology and strategic partner ecosystem across the UK. This role will be responsible for building strong relationships with existing partners, identifying and recruiting new strategic partners, and driving joint go-to-market initiatives that generate pipeline and revenue for Cobalt.

You will manage a diverse portfolio of partners, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security and IT consulting firms, and strategic alliance partners. Working closely with partners and internal teams, you will develop joint business plans, strengthen sales and marketing alignment, enable partner teams, and create opportunities to expand Cobalt's market presence.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who can balance strategic relationship management with day-to-day execution. You will own partner engagement and performance across your territory, driving measurable outcomes through partner-sourced pipeline, joint selling initiatives, and revenue growth.

What You Would Do

  • Partner Relationship Management: Own and grow relationships with strategic Cobalt partners across the UK, including technology vendors, OEMs, solution integrators, security software companies, and IT consulting firms.
  • Partner Recruitment & Development: Identify, engage, and develop new partner relationships while expanding the engagement and contribution of existing partners.
  • Joint Business Planning: Develop and execute partner business plans, go-to-market strategies, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) focused on generating pipeline, increasing partner engagement, and driving shared revenue.
  • Partner Enablement: Train and enable partner sales and technical teams to effectively position Cobalt's Pentest as a Service platform, communicate its value proposition, and identify opportunities within their customer base.
  • Joint Go-to-Market Execution: Build and execute collaborative marketing and sales initiatives, including co-branded content, campaigns, webinars, events, account mapping, lead-sharing programs, and joint customer engagements.
  • Pipeline & Revenue Growth: Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities through joint prospecting, referrals, co-selling, and reseller activities. Own partner pipeline reporting, forecasting, and progress against revenue targets.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Cobalt's Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to align partner priorities, support joint selling activities, and identify opportunities for deeper solution alignment and market expansion.
  • Partner Operations & Performance: Establish and maintain effective partner engagement processes, including pipeline governance, reporting, lead management, enablement resources, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Market Development: Identify opportunities to expand Cobalt's presence across EMEA technology and cybersecurity ecosystem through strategic partnerships, industry relationships, and joint market initiatives.

You Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in channel management or partner management within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity (preferrably).
  • Experience managing, developing, or supporting relationships with technology partners, solution integrators, resellers, OEMs, or strategic alliances.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategies, channel sales motions, and partner-led revenue generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, develop joint business plans, and drive measurable business outcomes through partners.
  • Experience developing and executing partner-facing marketing and sales initiatives, including joint campaigns, co-branded content, webinars, events, and account mapping.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Experience managing partner pipelines, tracking performance, and providing accurate reporting and forecasts.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple partner relationships and initiatives while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a quota-carrying role, with direct responsibility for pipeline generation or revenue targets.
  • Existing relationships within the UK and wider Europe cybersecurity, IT services, and technology partner ecosystem.
  • Experience selling or partnering within cybersecurity, penetration testing, or security services.
  • Familiarity with selling into IT and security leadership, including CISOs, CTOs, and other senior technology stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating partner agreements and managing complex partner or alliance relationships.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, PartnerStack, and other CRM or partner management platforms.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a scaling SaaS organization.

Why You Should Join Us

title: 3PL Operations Manager
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Europe 3PL operations manager

Position Overview

The European 3PL Manager owns Nebius's network of external warehouses and the performance of the 3PL partners who run them. The role ensures that high-value data center hardware stored and handled by third parties is received, stored, picked and shipped to the same standard as in Nebius-operated sites.

The manager controls 3PL operations through SLAs, KPIs, audits and system data, coordinates daily flows between 3PLs and internal teams (Transport, Planning, Back Office, ITDC, Security), and drives cost, compliance and continuous improvement across all external locations.

Key Responsibilities

  1. 3PL Network & Partner Management
  • Manage the portfolio of external warehouses and 3PL partners across EMEA/US/APAC.
  • Own contracts, SLAs and rate cards together with Procurement and Legal; prepare renewals and renegotiations.
  • Run monthly operational reviews and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with each 3PL; agree and track improvement plans.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for 3PL partners and for internal teams on 3PL-related issues.
  1. Operations Control
  • Set and enforce operating standards for 3PLs: receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch and returns (RMA).
  • Ensure 3PLs follow Nebius SOPs for handling heavy, fragile, high-value equipment (racks, GPU servers, HSM devices).
  • Monitor daily operational performance through WMS data, reports and site visits; act on deviations.
  • Lead root-cause analysis of incidents (damage, loss, mis-shipments, delays) and follow corrective and preventive actions to closure.
  1. Inventory Control & Audits
  • Ensure inventory accuracy at external sites: cycle counts, annual stock takes and reconciliation with ERP/WMS.
  • Organise periodic on-site audits and inspections of 3PL warehouses (process, security, safety, documentation).
  • Coordinate with Back Office on stock discrepancies, adjustments and asset records.
  • Support internal and external (SOX) audits for inventory held by third parties.
  1. Coordination with Internal Teams
  • Align inbound and outbound volumes with Logistics Planning and Transport so 3PLs have capacity and labour in time.
  • Coordinate with ITDC and Project Managers on staging, kitting and release of hardware to data center sites.
  • Work with Security on access control, CCTV, pre-arrival information and secure-storage requirements at 3PL sites.
  • Ensure accurate and timely data exchange between 3PL systems and Nebius ERP/WMS (integrations, ASNs, stock reports).
  1. Cost Management
  • Own the 3PL budget: storage, handling, value-added services and accessorial charges.
  • Validate 3PL invoices against contracts and actual activity together with Back Office; resolve disputes.
  • Track cost per pallet / rack / movement and identify savings through consolidation, space optimisation and renegotiation.
  1. Network Development: Onboarding & Exit
  • Assess needs for new external storage based on DC expansion plans and capacity forecasts.
  • Lead 3PL selection (RFI/RFQ, site assessment) with Procurement and onboard new partners: SOPs, system setup, training, go-live.
  • Manage 3PL exits and stock transfers with zero loss and full traceability.
  1. Compliance & Risk
  • Ensure 3PL operations meet security, safety, insurance and customs requirements (e.g. bonded storage where applicable).
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation on contracts, SLAs, audits and incidents.
  • Identify operational and dependency risks in the 3PL network and maintain contingency plans.
  1. Team Leadership
  • Lead 3PL / External Warehouse Specialists as the function scales; set priorities, onboard and develop them.
  • Define workflows, responsibilities and escalation paths between the 3PL team, Warehouse Operations and Transport.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI

Definition

SLA compliance

% of 3PL SLA targets met (dock-to-stock, order cycle time, on-time dispatch)

Inventory accuracy

% match between 3PL physical stock and Nebius ERP/WMS

Incident rate

Damage, loss and mis-shipment cases per 1,000 movements

CAPA closure

% of corrective actions closed by due date

Audit results

Score / findings from 3PL on-site audits and SOX tests

Cost per unit

3PL cost per pallet / rack / movement vs. budget

Invoice accuracy

% of 3PL invoices matching contract and activity without dispute

Expectations

Autonomy: Full ownership of the 3PL network and partner performance; escalates contract, budget and major-risk decisions.

Impact: Directly affects hardware availability, inventory accuracy and warehousing cost across all external sites.

Leadership: Leads 3PL specialists and steers partner teams without direct authority.

Travel: Regular trips to 3PL sites for audits, reviews and onboarding.

Work Mode: Hybrid, with regular presence at key logistics sites.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

title: Community Manager – French Speaking (12-Month Contract)
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are searching for a strategic community management and operations expert to join the International Community team and help grow Reddit outside of the US. As an integral part of the International Growth team, this role plays a key role in helping Reddit realize its mission: bringing community and belonging to everyone in the world.

This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland.

As the Community Manager, you will be at the forefront of jumpstarting and fostering local communities. You will be an expert of the French market, proficient in English and French, and focused on proactive initiatives to build bridges with local volunteer moderators and innovate, iterate, refine, and scale our international consumer playbook. The insights derived from your relationships and experiments will help accelerate our growth in the market.

What you will do:

  • Gain a deep understanding of the market to identify user and local moderator challenges, and market opportunities.
  • Iterate, innovate, and scale the consumer growth playbook by recognizing new opportunities, suggesting bold ideas and programs, and persuading internal teams to align on new plans.
  • Build strategic plans to cultivate, recruit, educate, and grow a local community of moderators (i.e., volunteers who develop, maintain, and shape the culture of local communities). Implement a conversion funnel designed to onboard power users and external creators, transforming them into active moderators.
  • Communicate quantitative and qualitative insights to optimize and improve the international consumer growth playbook.
  • Be obsessive about achieving aggressive goals and outcomes.
  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data, set KPIs, and execute impactful community initiatives: leverage data to uncover community and moderator insights that will influence the direction of the local team in the market.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Community, Engineering, Marketing, Safety, and BD teams.

What We Can Expect From You:

  • 5+ years of community development, project management, growth, operations, or product consulting experience with a track record of community-led projects that have driven business impact.
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of French culture, including current events, politics, customs, traditions, language, topics of interest, and taboos.
  • Nuanced comprehension of the digital landscape and the cultural intricacies inherent within it, including awareness of internet culture specific to France and an appreciation for the diverse cultural facets shaping contemporary French society.
  • Succinct and persuasive communicator: able to collaborate effectively across internal teams, local users, moderators, partners, content creators, influencers, etc.
  • Results-obsessed: demonstrates outstanding execution and high attention to detail.
  • Deep interest in developing and driving projects, framing issues and seeking solutions, testing hypotheses, and iterating on process improvements.
  • Proficiency in French & English.

London OR Cardiff OR Remote (UK) | 💰 £51,200- £64,700 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits ✨

Our mission is to make money work for everyone. And while having a great app is part of that, we pride ourselves on providing world-class support. By solving customers' problems, treating them fairly and being transparent, we believe we can make banking better 💪

Our Complaints team works alongside Customer Operations to make sure customers receive the best possible service, even when things go wrong. We put empathy at the heart of how we handle complaints and use what we learn to make things better.

As our Complaints Policy Manager, you'll lead a team of technical experts and shape how we handle complaints across Monzo. You'll bring together regulatory requirements, customer needs and operational priorities to make sure our policies are clear, effective and fair. You'll play an important role in strengthening our complaints framework, influencing decisions across the business and helping us deliver better customer outcomes at scale.

🔑You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Complaints Lead Experts, creating an environment where people can grow and deliver high-quality technical advice.

  • Owning and improving our complaints policy framework, making sure processes, guidance, systems and customer communications are consistent, effective and meet regulatory expectations.

  • Providing oversight and direction on complex complaint handling issues, supporting teams to make fair, well-informed decisions across different complaint types.

  • Using insights from quality assurance, Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) outcomes and escalations to identify root causes, shape our strategy and drive meaningful improvements.

  • Partnering with Product, Legal, Risk, Compliance and Operations leaders to develop and embed policies, frameworks and operational changes that improve customer experiences.

  • Leading our response to regulatory developments, audits and compliance reviews, making sure our controls, reporting and governance remain robust.

  • Overseeing specialist activities, including regulatory disclosures, legal escalations and engagement with third parties, to make sure we meet our obligations and deliver fair customer outcomes.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have strong knowledge of UK complaint-handling regulations, including the FCA's DISP handbook and FOS requirements, and can apply them to real customer situations.

  • You're experienced in leading, coaching and developing technical specialists, helping them build confidence and deliver great outcomes.

  • You can see the bigger picture, using complaint data, quality insights and emerging trends to shape strategy and improve how things work.

  • You're comfortable managing regulatory governance, control frameworks, audits and changes to regulatory requirements.

  • You can build strong relationships across different teams, influence senior stakeholders and turn complex regulatory information into clear, practical guidance.

  • You're confident balancing long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational challenges, making thoughtful decisions and keeping things moving.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager, Professional Services to join our team. This is a Remote (UK) role, reporting to the Manager, Professional Services in the Professional Services department. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Professional Services organisation, leading the successful delivery of customer-facing projects. This role is responsible for managing complex engagements from initiation through closure, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to a high standard of quality. With your deep understanding of Content Management Systems (CMS) and web technologies, you'll provide expert assistance to clients, ensuring seamless experiences and resolving challenges with precision.

• Meet or exceed customer expectations on response quality and SLA within our ticketing platform and live chat.

• Educate customers on product features, functionalities, and best practices.

• Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude in all customer interactions.

• Collaborate with tech support, sales representatives, and partner account managers to resolve issues efficiently and effectively.

• Contribute to identifying inefficiencies in support processes and suggest improvements to enhance productivity and customer satisfaction.

• Assist in training the Technical Support Engineer I and provide mentorship as needed.

• Handle customer escalations from Technical Support Engineer I, addressing concerns promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.

• Participate in customer video calls when appropriate to troubleshoot complex technical issues live, helping reduce back-and-forth communication and speed up resolution for high-priority or advanced customer cases.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of Support Engineering, Software Engineering experience.

• Thorough knowledge with consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

• Working knowledge of at least one modern JavaScript framework such as Vue.js, React, Next.js, or Nuxt.js and their fundamental principles.

• Ability to debug and troubleshoot applications built with modern JavaScript frameworks (required).

• Thorough knowledge of JavaScript and its modern syntax and features. Experience with Typescript is a plus.

• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.

• Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus.

• Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.

• Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues in real time with customers or internal stakeholders (e.g., via screen sharing or video calls) is a plus.

• Remote working experience.

• Well-organized, self-starting, has excellent work ethic, and pays attention to detail.

• A proactive approach to day-to-day tasks while also going above and beyond with continuous improvement as a core driving principle.

• Ability to work independently with little direct supervision.

• Real passion for solving issues and challenges.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

title: Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable
description:
Headquarters: California; New York; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Georgia; Remote - Ohio; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Pennsylvania; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington; Remote - Washington D.C.

 GAQ327R240

 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale.

 Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.

 The impact you will have:

• Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.

• Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance

• Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.

• Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.

• Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.

• Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.

• Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

 What we look for:

• Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.

• Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

• Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

• Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.

• Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.

• M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.

• The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus.

• Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.

• Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

title: Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role:

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

What you'll do:

  • Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

  • Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

  • Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

  • Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

  • Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

  • Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

  • Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

  • Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

  • Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

  • Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Consultant Rheumatologist PAYE
description:
About the role

We are seeking a permanent Consultant Rheumatologist to join our dynamic team. You will play a pivotal role in assessing and managing patients with conditions such as Fibromyalgia and Osteoarthritis, exploring medical cannabis treatment options. This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of medical cannabis treatment in the UK within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Rheumatology

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £210,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

description:

You'll lead technical evaluations, deliver compelling demos, and guide customers through the journey from discovery to successful adoption.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, bridging business goals with technical solutions, and play a key role in winning new business and expanding existing accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover technical challenges, business goals, and success criteria, then translate those needs into tailored Datadog solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, and workshops that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Project manage technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify and cultivate technical champions within customer accounts, empowering them to advocate for Datadog adoption and drive consensus internally
  • Participat e actively in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, serving as the technical voice of the customer to help shape product direction
  • Maintain operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and GTM teams to address customer needs and resolve technical blockers

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at navigating multi-stakeholder environments and adapting communication style to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Proficient background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Staff Firmware Engineer
description:
Staff Firmware Engineer

Embedded/Firmware Engineers at Lunar will be responsible for the full product development lifecycle of our products’ firmware and software, which are important sources of functionality, adaptability, and optimization of our designs. We are looking for people who are passionate about a more sustainable future, and want to make that vision a reality. An ideal candidate is excited and ready to collaborate closely with a dedicated, cross-functional team to deliver innovative, best-in-class products. Engineers at Lunar are hands-on and involved in all aspects of the product, and own the design from forming concepts based on first principles to managing high-volume production quality.

Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

On a given day at Lunar, you’ll likely…

  • Develop wireless network communication solutions for high-volume products, ensuring continuous 24/7 reliability
  • Design firmware software that runs in our home energy product components: RF communication protocols, mobile app interfaces, system diagnostics and updates.
  • Drive design discussions on system architecture to achieve the desired product functionality.
  • Collaborate with the team on design and development, including participating in code reviews.
  • Work collaboratively with other disciplines across the company to continuously refine and improve our understanding of how our products can create the greatest impact, get to market quickly, and operate reliably for our customers

Desired Skills:

  • Degree in a computer-engineering related or adjacent field, or demonstrated commensurate ability.
  • 5+ years experience delivering firmware for new products as part of a team.
  • Proficiency in C, and working familiarity with Python. Rust knowledge is nice to have.
  • Experience working with IP stack protocols: Ethernet, WiFi, TCP, UDP, HTTPS, etc
  • Working knowledge of Bluetooth/BLE.
  • Experience working with WiFi networks and Espressif ecosystem
  • Working knowledge of Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers and other lab test equipment

Benefits:

We’re dedicated to creating a remarkable employee experience. At Lunar, competitive base pay is one part of our total compensation package. Lunar employees also have the opportunity to become Lunar shareholders by getting equity in a fast-growing company and participating in our employee stock program.

Additional benefits include:

  • Competitive salary and stock options package
  • Private Medical Insurance scheme through BUPA (medical history disregarded)
  • A wellbeing and lifestyle benefits plan through Medicash
  • 5% employer contributions pension matching
  • A budget for work related training of £1,000 per financial year and an allowance of 4 training days
  • Cycle To Work scheme and Workplace Nursery benefit
  • Access to Spill - Mental Health Support platform
  • Enhanced Maternity + Paternity Pay
  • 25 days annual holiday entitlement + 8 Bank Holidays
  • Flexible start and finish times, fully remote working or hybrid depending on preferences

Our DE&I Philosophy: Lunar Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, developing and retaining diverse talent by supporting an inclusive workplace. Lunar recruits, hires, trains, promotes, compensates, and administers all personnel actions without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Human Resources Business Partner (L&D/Projects)
description:
HR Business Partner

Learning & Development | People Projects | Policy Development


Chelmsford Learning Partnership | Chelmsford


37 hours per week - All year round


Scale 11 — £49,282 - £53,460


Are you passionate about developing people, improving organisations and turning ideas into meaningful change?


Do you enjoy bringing people together, developing new approaches and making a positive difference to people's working lives?


Chelmsford Learning Partnership is looking for an enthusiastic, proactive and motivated HR Business Partner to join our central HR team.


This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious HR professional who wants to broaden their experience and make a meaningful contribution to how we develop, support and engage our workforce.


Working closely with the Director of People, you will play an important role in delivering the Trust's People Strategy, with a particular focus on learning and development, people projects, policy development and continuous improvement.


You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of projects, coordinate learning initiatives, support the development of managers and help shape the policies, processes and resources that support colleagues across our family of schools.


This is a varied role for someone who enjoys being organised, developing ideas and seeing projects through to successful delivery.


What will you be doing?


You'll work across the Trust, supporting a range of people priorities and helping turn strategic objectives into practical activities that make a difference.


Learning & Development

Support the identification of learning and development needs across our schools and central team.

Coordinate and support the delivery of training, workshops and development programmes.

Help develop engaging learning resources, guidance and materials for managers and employees.

Support managers to build their confidence and capability in managing people effectively.

Gather feedback and evaluate learning activities to help improve our development offer.

Promote learning opportunities and encourage participation across the Trust.

People Projects & Continuous Improvement

Coordinate and deliver agreed people projects, taking ownership of project plans, actions, milestones and progress.

Work with colleagues across the Trust to implement new initiatives and improve existing practices.

Identify opportunities to make HR processes more effective, accessible and consistent.

Monitor progress, identify potential challenges and ensure actions are followed through.

Contribute to the delivery of the Trust's People Strategy and People priorities.

Prepare project updates, communications and reports to demonstrate progress and outcomes.

Policy Development & HR Support

Support the drafting, review and development of HR policies, procedures and guidance.

Research good practice, gather feedback and coordinate consultation activities.

Help ensure policies and guidance are practical, accessible and consistently applied.

Provide day-to-day HR advice and support on routine employee matters, recognising when more complex issues require escalation.

Support recruitment, onboarding and the preparation of routine employment documentation.

Maintain accurate HR records and contribute to the development of HR resources and information available to schools.

What are we looking for?


We're looking for someone who is organised, collaborative and enthusiastic about developing people and improving organisational practice.


You will ideally have:


At least part-qualified towards a Level 5 CIPD qualification, with a commitment to completing it.

A good working knowledge of HR policies, procedures and relevant employment legislation.

Experience supporting or coordinating learning and development activities.

Experience coordinating projects, managing actions and working towards agreed deadlines.

The ability to research information and contribute to the development of policies, procedures and guidance.

Excellent organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work with colleagues at different levels.

Good written communication and presentation skills, including the ability to develop engaging learning materials and guidance.

Confidence using Microsoft Office and HR systems.

A practical, solution-focused approach and the ability to work independently within agreed responsibilities.

An understanding of equality, diversity, inclusion and safeguarding within an educational environment.


Experience within education or a multi-site organisation would be beneficial but is not essential.


Above all, we're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys working collaboratively and is motivated by the opportunity to make a positive difference.


Why join Chelmsford Learning Partnership?


At CLP, we're committed to creating great places to work and learn. Our central team plays an important role in supporting our schools and ensuring colleagues have the resources, development and support they need to thrive.


Joining us means becoming part of a collaborative and ambitious organisation where your ideas and contribution can make a real difference.


You'll have the opportunity to:


Take ownership of projects and see your ideas translated into practice.

Help shape learning and development opportunities across the Trust.

Work closely with the Director of People and colleagues across our schools.

Contribute to the development of policies and people practices.

Develop your own HR knowledge, skills and professional qualifications.

Build relationships across a diverse family of schools.

Make a tangible difference to the experience of colleagues and managers.

Our benefits


We offer a range of benefits to support your wellbeing, development and work-life balance, including:


Access to a confidential 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme.

Flexible and family-friendly policies, with flexible working arrangements open for discussion at the point of appointment.

Employee benefits platform offering a range of valuable discounts.

Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Technology Scheme.

24/7 GP access.

Ready to make a difference?


If you're an HR professional looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience, develop your skills and contribute to projects that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.


Bring your ideas, enthusiasm and passion for developing people. Help us shape the future of our workforce at Chelmsford Learning Partnership.


Although a closing date is published, we reserve the right to close this vacancy early and commence interviews should we receive sufficient applications. Early applications are therefore strongly encouraged.


The Chelmsford Learning Partnership is committed within its schools to:


Safeguarding and promoting the welfare and safety, and the spiritual and cultural development of children and young people;

Promoting equality of opportunity and community cohesion where the diversity of different backgrounds and circumstances is appreciated and positively valued;

The fundamental British values of democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty and mutual respect and tolerance for those with different faiths and beliefs and expects all staff, volunteers and other workers to share in this commitment.

description:
Winchmore is a large, thriving, and fast-paced secondary school serving over 1800 students across a substantial, multi-building campus. We are looking for a practical, proactive, and reliable Premises Team Member to join our dedicated Premises team. The Hours are 41-45 hours per week (2,137-2,346 annualised hours) on a shift rota, as required to meet the needs of the School. The Shift pattern is as follows - Early: 5.30am to 2.30pm, Middle: 8.00am to 5.00pm, Late: 1.30pm to 10.30pm, and every 3rd Saturday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Site Security: Act as a designated keyholder, carrying out daily opening and locking-up procedures, setting security alarms, and responding to out-of-hours call-outs on a rota basis.

  • Health & Safety Compliance: Conduct and log routine statutory checks (including fire alarm tests, emergency lighting, and water temperature/legionella flushing) and report any hazards promptly.

  • Events, Exams & Porterage: Set up and clear down furniture and equipment for assemblies, public examinations, parents’ evenings, and community lettings, as well as managing parcel and stock deliveries.

  • Grounds & Presentation: Maintain clean, litter-free external areas, clear leaves and snow during winter months, and support the cleaning team with urgent daytime spillages or hygiene needs.

  • Contractor Liaison: Escort external contractors on site, ensuring they adhere to school safeguarding and Health & Safety protocols.

What We Are Looking For

  • Practical experience in building maintenance, a trade, caretaking, or general DIY, with the confidence to use a variety of hand and power tools safely.

  • An awareness of Health & Safety legislation and safe working practices (training in areas such as Manual Handling, Working at Height, and Legionella awareness will be provided).

  • The physical fitness required for manual handling, lifting, and working across a large, multi-storey site.

  • A calm, adaptable, and customer-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively within a team and under pressure and prioritise tasks in a busy school environment.

  • Flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern, including early mornings, late evenings, and every 3rd Saturday.

What We Offer
  • Winchmore is known for being a friendly and supportive School Community. We provide a range of well-being activities and facilities, good transport links, free local parking, a cycle to work scheme, use of a brand new fitness suite. We value our staff and recognise the importance of maintaining a healthy work life balance.

You will share opening, locking and key-holding with the Site Manager so that the site is covered across the school day, and you will work four weeks of the school holidays, when much of our maintenance and the annual deep clean take place.

Our school

Our building is purpose-built and open-plan by design, at the heart of the Eddington community in north-west Cambridge. The environment is part of how children learn here, so the way the site looks, feels and works matters. We welcome visitors and delegations from across the world, and we want every one of them to see a building that is cared for.

We work in a spirit of trust. That comes with high expectations and high accountability, and with a supportive team who are ambitious for our children.

Who we are looking for

You will have practical craft skills and experience of building maintenance, a good understanding of health and safety (we will provide training), a sharp eye for detail and the confidence to work on your own initiative. You will be as comfortable fixing a door as you are talking with a child about why you are fixing it. You will be flexible, calm when something goes wrong, and someone who takes pride in a job done properly.

What we offer

A friendly, two-person site team and a supportive wider team

Training and development, including health and safety and compliance training

Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme

A well-being day each year and access to an Employee Assistance Programme

Cycle to Work scheme, a University Visit Card and discounted membership of the University Sports Centre

Find out more and apply

Visits to the school are warmly welcomed. To arrange one, or for an informal conversation about the role, please email enquiries@universityprimaryschool.org.uk.

Please apply through MyNewTerm, using the person specification to show how you meet each criterion. Shortlisting is based on the evidence in your application.

UCPS is a standalone academy trust. All team members are employed by the trust, not by the University of Cambridge.

In line with Keeping Children Safe in Education, we may carry out online searches on shortlisted candidates. This post is subject to an enhanced DBS check, including a children's barred list check, and satisfactory references. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
FIXED TERM - 1 YEAR

We are delighted to be growing our SEND team and are looking for a proactive Learning Support Assistant to join our hardworking and inclusive environment. This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is committed to nurturing the whole child, ensuring that every pupil receives the tailored support they need to achieve their full academic and social potential.

We are seeking a candidate who can bring either some subject knowledge or have a genuine interest for supporting students with their learning. Your enthusiasm will be key in helping our students unlock the curriculum, as you find creative ways to bring subjects to life for learners with varying barriers to learning.

We are looking for a professional who thrives on variety and possesses the flexibility to adapt across the school as required. You will be someone that is able to step in where support is needed and will have the greatest impact on our pupils' day.

At the Sele School, our purpose is to enrich the lives of every single young person and empower every child to successfully write their next chapter —whether that is further education, employment, or training. We explicitly measure our success by the long-term readiness and future security of our students. Our Three Core Values are: Belong, Thrive and Succeed.

The Successful Candidate will:

  • Prioritise Connection: You understand that "connection before correction" is the foundation of success, bringing a natural ability to build warm, positive relationships that help our pupils feel safe and ready to learn.
  • Be a Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working as part of an expanding team. You are happy to take direction and move fluidly to wherever the school or our pupils need you most, always putting their needs at the heart of your day.
  • Combine Subject & SEND Knowledge: You bring a strong toolkit of subject knowledge and SEND understanding. This expertise allows you to break down barriers to learning, providing the informed support and "scaffolding" pupils need to master new skills.
  • Show Initiative: You have the confidence to work independently and the "thinking on your feet" skills required to adapt in the moment, ensuring support remains effective even when situations change.
  • Communicate with Purpose: You possess excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues, parents, and pupils at all levels.
  • Bring Positivity: You approach challenges with a resilient "can-do" attitude and a good sense of humour that inspires those around you.
  • Promote The Sele School’s ethos and values.

What can we offer you?

The chance to work in a positive, welcoming and forward-thinking community where evidence-based methods are seamlessly integrated into teaching and learning.

A dedicated staff who are enthusiastic and who want the best for students.

Coaching provision for all those new to the school within a comprehensive and fully developed induction programme.

A CPD package which is tailored to suit your stage of career development.

Cycle to work scheme which is part of the school’s sustainability strategy.

If you wish to learn more about the school, please feel free to view the videos on our school website which can be found on the “About Us - School Vision and Ethos” page.

We understand some may wish to see the school in action. If you wish to visit the school or meet on Teams, please contact the Heads PA at hr@sele.herts.sch.uk

Applications must be made using the school application form (CVs, or applications made using any other format, will not be accepted) and should be emailed to the address above for the attention of Madeline Genovese, to be considered for interview.

The Sele School community is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and all staff and volunteers are expected to demonstrate this commitment in all aspects of their work. Applicants for this post must be willing to undergo child protection training. A full enhanced DBS check will be undertaken and references will be sought prior to appointment start date.

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Exams Officer to support the effective administration and delivery of examinations across the College. Working closely with the Exams Manager, you will ensure all examination processes are conducted efficiently, securely and in full compliance with JCQ and awarding body regulations.

You will be responsible for coordinating learner registrations, examination entries, assessments and certification processes, ensuring all awarding body deadlines are met. The role will involve liaising with awarding organisations, maintaining secure exam materials, supporting access arrangements, coordinating invigilation activities and providing guidance to staff on examination procedures.
